prompt: Write readable Python source only with no semicolons. Implement seed_windows(scan,query,molecule_length,max_windows=20), returning sorted unique (left,right) windows. Once max_windows distinct windows have been added return immediately. Otherwise return after all seeds. Both loops must terminate. Search_from increases to pos+1 after every match. No alignment, no IO, no extra functions. Under30 lines.
